capability.environment: Claude Code cloud container: Node 22, FFmpeg 6.1, @napi-rs/canvas; no image-generation tool, no authorized TTS call

limitations.observed: No image-generation tool available in this environment; figures and props were drawn procedurally with canvas code (tools/make-art.mjs)
limitations.impact: Drawing quality is a readable draft, not equivalent to the B1 Ryan V4 baseline; replace or redraw assets before final acceptance

limitations.observed: Narration generation is billable and was not authorized in this session; voice.path is a silent 180 s placeholder
limitations.impact: Captions and shot timing follow the planned 12x15 s storyboard, not actual speech; re-align after recording narasi.md

limitations.observed: No licensed track was available offline; only a procedural room-tone bed and procedural SFX are mixed
limitations.impact: Completeness gate for sample-directed music is not met until a licensed track is added
